messages.author: 082f297c4d32eea2
messages.subject: Avoid overlapping tip labels
parts:
Hey!

Is there a way to avoid a tip label overlap in big trees? I have a tree with over 400 tips and have to keep the label font size really small to avoid overlaps. I saw the link to ggrepel in the FAQ, but that only works with a defined "label" class, and geom_tiplab(2) doesn't support that. Or am I doing something wrong?

Thanks in advance for your help!
Sarah

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Avoid overlapping tip labels
parts: see my answer in https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/faq.html#enlarge-center-space.

messages.author: 6c928594bcdd6fa5
messages.subject: Re: Avoid overlapping tip labels
parts:
Hi Sarah,

You Just need to provide more space for the tree when saving. You can Control It by using ggsave(height = x). By providing more space, tips should not overlap anymore. 

Cheers,

Pedro.
